description: Migrate a stateful workload (a Java microservice with a PostgreSQL database and Redis cache) from AWS to GCP. The migration must follow this sequence: provision GCP infrastructure (GCE instances, Cloud SQL, Memorystore), replicate state (PostgreSQL via Cloud SQL migration, Redis via replication bridge), establish cross-cloud network connectivity (VPC peering or Cloud VPN), run a dual-run period (traffic to both clouds via a global load balancer), execute cutover (drain AWS, promote GCP to primary), verify in GCP, and teardown AWS resources (terminate EC2, drop RDS, delete ElastiCache). A rollback plan must exist (fail back to AWS, promote AWS RDS to primary). Risk factors: cross-cloud data replication lag, region/zone naming differences (AWS AZ vs GCP zone), provider-pair sequencing (source teardown must happen only after target is verified), and cost of dual-run. Tools available: AWS DMS, GCP Database Migration Service, Terraform, Cloud VPN, Cloud Load Balancing, gcloud, aws-cli.
